covers: US open and first hour on Tue 24 Nov 2026, US consumer confidence, JSE and rand during Tuesday
headline: US consumer confidence jumps to 103.3, far above forecasts, while chip stocks give back part of Monday's rally; Nvidia down about 5.6%
summary: In South Africa the rand weakened to about R17.54 per dollar by 16:03 SAST and the Top 40 was down about 0.6%, while the SARB's leading indicator fell 0.3% in September (Reuters via MarketScreener, 24 Nov 2026). In the US, Conference Board consumer confidence rose to 103.3 in November from 91.9 against a 92.1 forecast, but chip stocks fell at the open, leaving the Nasdaq down 1.55% and the S&P 500 down 0.61% around 17:17 SAST, with the Dow up 0.37% (Conference Board; Yahoo Finance, 24 Nov 2026). Gold eased 1.3% to about $3,605 an ounce; for South Africa the next tests are US PCE inflation on Wednesday and the Moody's and S&P reviews late on Friday 27 Nov.

items.title: US consumer confidence surges to 103.3, the highest since January 2025
items.summary: The Conference Board index rose 11.4 points to 103.3 in November from 91.9 in October (Conference Board, 24 Nov 2026), well above the 92.1 consensus listed by Yahoo Finance the same morning. The Conference Board's economist linked part of the jump to lower uncertainty after the midterm elections. A stronger consumer can keep pressure on the Fed ahead of Wednesday's PCE inflation data.

items.title: Nvidia falls about 5.6% after Monday's 31.5% jump; chip stocks slide
items.summary: Nvidia was down 5.64% against Monday's close at 10:01 New York time (17:01 SAST), giving back part of the 31.48% gain that followed Jensen Huang's reinstatement as CEO. AMD was down 8.03%, Micron 7.67% and Analog Devices 15.59% after its results (StockTitan, 24 Nov 2026).

items.title: Nasdaq down 1.55%, S&P 500 down 0.61%, Dow up 0.37% in the first hour
items.summary: Around 10:17 New York time (17:17 SAST) the S&P 500 was at 7,192.92 (-0.61%), the Nasdaq at 23,716.58 (-1.55%) and the Dow at 49,778.88 (+0.37%); the VIX rose 2.7% to 27.35. The US 10-year yield was little changed at 4.916% (Yahoo Finance, 24 Nov 2026). This follows Monday's best session since April 2025.

items.title: Analog Devices falls 15.6% despite 42% revenue growth; HPE down 13%
items.summary: Analog Devices reported revenue up 42% to $4.37 billion and guided to $4.4 billion plus or minus $150 million, but the shares were down 15.59% at 10:01 New York time. HPE was down 13.14% after its outlook showed lower margins (StockTitan, 24 Nov 2026).

items.title: Sanofi agrees to buy Insmed for about $41 billion; retailers rally
items.summary: Sanofi will pay $175 a share in cash for Insmed, still subject to approvals; Insmed was up 14.39%. Abercrombie & Fitch (+22.47%), Dick's (+14.28%) and Dollar Tree (+9.86%) rose after results (StockTitan, 24 Nov 2026, 10:01 New York time).

items.title: Traders price a December Fed rate hike; PCE and GDP on Wednesday
items.summary: Yahoo Finance reported traders pricing a 95% chance of a 25 basis point Fed hike in December (24 Nov 2026). US GDP and PCE inflation are due at 15:30 SAST on Wednesday 25 Nov; US markets are closed on Thursday and close early on Friday.

items.title: Rand weakens about 0.8% to R17.54; Top 40 down about 0.6%
items.summary: The rand traded at 17.5399 per dollar at 16:03 SAST, about 0.8% weaker than Monday's close, and the Top 40 was down about 0.6%. The 2035 government bond yield rose half a basis point to 8.665% (Reuters via MarketScreener, 24 Nov 2026).

items.title: SARB leading indicator falls 0.3% in September
items.summary: The Reserve Bank's composite leading business cycle indicator fell 0.3% month on month in September, and the Treasury sold R1.95 billion of bonds at its weekly auction (Reuters via MarketScreener, 24 Nov 2026).

items.title: Moody's and S&P reviews of South Africa due late on Friday 27 Nov
items.summary: Both agencies have South Africa on positive outlooks; the decisions are expected after the JSE close on Friday.

items.title: Gold eases 1.3% to about $3,605
items.summary: Gold futures were at $3,605.10, down $46.30 (-1.27%), around 17:17 SAST, after Monday's 3.5% rally to about $3,657 (Yahoo Finance; PSG Wealth, 24 Nov 2026).

items.title: Brent near $89, WTI near $80 in Asian trade
items.summary: Brent was at $89.09 and WTI at $80.16 during Asian trade on Tuesday, little changed after Monday's fall to three-month lows (TipRanks, 24 Nov 2026).

items.title: Nvidia down about 5.6% on Tuesday (rating BUY, unchanged)
items.summary: The pullback follows Monday's 31.48% jump on Jensen Huang's return (StockTitan, 24 Nov 2026). The shares remain well below our watchlist fair value of $262.56; the rating is unchanged.

items.title: Dell reports after the US close tonight (rating SELL, unchanged)
items.summary: Dell fell about 7% in pre-market trade ahead of its results, which are due after the close with the call at 23:30 SAST (Yahoo Finance; StockTitan, 24 Nov 2026). Our SELL rating is unchanged; the results will be covered in the morning brief.
